name: Work_Items
description: Core table tracking all facilities management work items from intake through to completion and payment. Each record represents a single maintenance request, repair job, or scheduled work item reported via WhatsApp or other channels.
record_count_estimate: High volume - expect thousands of records per month across all sites

fields.name: work_item_id
fields.description: Unique auto-incrementing identifier for each work item

fields.name: title
fields.description: Short descriptive title for the work item, typically LLM-generated from the initial message

fields.name: description
fields.description: Full description of the issue or work required, including any details extracted from WhatsApp messages

fields.name: current_state
fields.description: Current state of the work item in the state machine lifecycle

fields.name: state_started_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the work item entered its current state

fields.name: state_history
fields.description: JSON array recording all state transitions. Each entry contains: from_state, to_state, trigger, timestamp, actor_id, and notes

fields.name: state_locked
fields.description: When true, prevents automated state transitions. Used during manual review or dispute resolution

fields.name: site_id
fields.description: Link to the site where this work item is located

fields.name: reported_by
fields.description: Link to the person who reported this issue, typically a tenant or property manager

fields.name: assigned_engineer_id
fields.description: Link to the internal engineer assigned to this work item (used when assigned_resource_type=INTERNAL)

fields.name: contractor_id
fields.description: Link to the external contractor assigned to this work item (used when assigned_resource_type=EXTERNAL)

fields.name: assigned_resource_type
fields.description: Whether the job is assigned to an internal engineer or external contractor. Set by hybrid assignment logic during ASSESSMENT.

fields.name: discipline_required
fields.description: The trade discipline required to complete this work item

fields.name: urgency
fields.description: Urgency level determining SLA timescales. EMERGENCY triggers immediate response protocols

fields.name: llm_extracted_data
fields.description: JSON object containing structured data extracted by the LLM from inbound WhatsApp messages. Includes identified issue type, location hints, urgency indicators, and any other parsed information

fields.name: llm_confidence
fields.description: Confidence score (0.00 to 1.00) from the LLM extraction process. Scores below 0.75 trigger supervisor review

fields.name: needs_review
fields.description: When true, the work item has been flagged for supervisor review due to low AI confidence (< 0.75), AI fallback activation, or contractor assignment failure. Items with this flag are NOT auto-assigned.

fields.name: reasoning_summary
fields.description: Short text summary from the AI triage explaining the classification rationale. Always populated on AI triage, including fallback cases.

fields.name: location_building
fields.description: Building name or number within the site

fields.name: location_floor
fields.description: Floor level within the building (e.g. Ground, 1st, 2nd, Basement)

fields.name: location_unit
fields.description: Unit or suite number within the building

fields.name: location_area
fields.description: Specific area within the unit (e.g. Kitchen, WC, Reception, Server Room)

fields.name: routing_decision
fields.description: Triage outcome determining whether work is handled internally, sent to an external contractor, or requires further clarification

fields.name: completion_evidence_url
fields.description: URL to uploaded photographic or documentary evidence of completed work

fields.name: completion_notes
fields.description: Engineer or contractor notes on the completed work, including any follow-up recommendations

fields.name: verification_confidence
fields.description: Claude Vision confidence score (0-100) from the photo verification assessment. Scores >= 85 auto-approve to PAYMENT_PENDING.

fields.name: verification_reason
fields.description: Claude Vision reasoning for the verification decision. Max 150 chars from the model, may include additional context.

fields.name: verification_photo
fields.description: URL of the contractor's verification photo retrieved from 360dialog media API

fields.name: sla_due_at
fields.description: Deadline by which the work item must be resolved according to the applicable SLA

fields.name: escalation_level
fields.description: Current escalation level (0 = no escalation, increments with each SLA breach interval)

fields.name: blocked_reason
fields.description: Reason the work item is currently blocked, populated when transitioning to ON_HOLD state

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the work item record was first created

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to any field on this record

fields.name: closed_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the work item was closed or cancelled

fields.name: whatsapp_thread_id
fields.description: WhatsApp conversation thread identifier linking this work item to its originating chat

fields.name: source_message_id
fields.description: WhatsApp message ID of the original message that triggered this work item

fields.name: cost_estimate
fields.description: Estimated cost for completing the work, used for budgeting and approval workflows

fields.name: actual_cost
fields.description: Actual cost incurred for the completed work

fields.name: time_in_current_state
fields.description: Calculated hours the work item has spent in its current state

fields.name: is_overdue
fields.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the work item has breached its SLA deadline

fields.name: days_since_created
fields.description: Number of calendar days since the work item was created

fields.name: priority_score
fields.description: Composite priority score combining urgency level and escalation count. Used for queue ordering

views.name: All Work Items
views.description: Complete list of all work items across all states

views.name: Active Work
views.description: Work items currently in progress, excluding closed and cancelled items

views.name: Overdue Items
views.description: Work items that have breached their SLA deadline

views.name: By Engineer
views.description: Work items grouped by assigned engineer for workload management

views.name: RFQ Pipeline
views.description: Work items routed to external contractors, for managing the request-for-quote pipeline

views.name: Emergency Queue
views.description: Emergency work items requiring immediate attention

views.name: Kanban Board
views.description: Visual kanban board showing work items grouped by their current state

views.name: Verification Queue
views.description: Work items awaiting photo verification, showing Claude Vision assessment results

views.name: Supervisor Review Queue
views.description: Work items flagged for supervisor review due to low AI confidence, fallback activation, or unassigned contractors
